hilosenda es un asistente de IA que trab:
hilosenda is an AI assistant that works inside a folder on your computer: it can read your files, write code, fix bugs and run commands for you.

STEP 1 · Connect an AI
  Press «Connect an AI». If Ollama or LM Studio are open, they are detected automatically.
  If you prefer a cloud AI (Claude, GPT, Gemini...), paste your API key and that's it:
  hilosenda finds all available models automatically.

STEP 2 · Choose a folder
  Press «Choose folder» and select your project folder in the window that opens.

STEP 3 · Chat
  Press «Start chatting», type what you need in plain language and press Enter.
  Examples:  «explain what this project does»
             «create a web page with a contact form»
             «there's an error on startup, fix it»

INSIDE THE CHAT
  · The buttons let you change model, reasoning, folder, permissions and more.
  · The «Menu» button shows ALL features with an explanation of each.
  · All Pi commands also work: type / to see them.
  · Esc stops the AI while it's working. Ctrl+C twice leaves the chat.
  · Use the mouse wheel to scroll through the conversation.

PERMISSIONS
  By default the AI asks before changing files or running commands.
  You can change it in «Permissions»: Free (doesn't ask) or Read only (changes nothing).

INSTRUCTIONS
  You can choose any .md or .txt file with rules for the AI (language, style,
  technologies to use...). The AI reads it before every reply.
